content.short: Garden is a super-fast native Bitcoin exchange enabling BTC to any asset in under 10 minutes.
content.description: Garden is a fast, native Bitcoin exchange launched in December 2023 by a team formerly with RenBTC. Unlike traditional bridges, it uses Hashed Timelocked Contracts (HTLCs) with instant confirmation, removing the need for third-party custodians and letting users maintain full control of their assets. Traders can swap BTC for any supported asset directly in the Garden UI, and dApps or wallets can add instant native BTC support through the Garden SDK.
